tools.name: get_news
tools.description: GDELT DOC 2.0 ArtList (JSON), newest first. query uses GDELT syntax (keywords, "phrases", OR, domain:, sourcelang:, theme: …) and is required by GDELT; since (ISO date/datetime) becomes startdatetime and must be within the last 3 months; maxrecords ≤ 250 (capped at 100). There is no paging — ignore next_page. published_at is GDELT's seendate (YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ); language and sourcecountry are in raw. When called more than once per 5 s GDELT answers a plain-text notice instead of JSON (articles is then empty). The ~40 RSS/Atom feeds, Tree of Alpha, Binance announcements and Fear & Greed collected by this entry's source are not mapped.
